summary: Test whether the existence and reciprocity of a structural connection changes functional coupling strength, by classifying every zebrafish region pair as unconnected / unidirectional / bidirectional from the directed structural connectome, pooling the per-larva FC values in each class, and comparing the three distributions with a one-way ANOVA.
use_when: Analyze directionality of structural connections vs functional coupling strength
Generate directionality of structural connections vs functional coupling strength outputs
avoid_when: Connectivity estimates are unsupported because sampling, preprocessing, or matrix alignment is inadequate
Independent biological replicates or an appropriate null model are unavailable
